title: Dual-Silo CLI Consolidation, Slotted Domain Engine Architecture, and IoC Service Elevation (discovery-index-scout)
author: Brain Harness Autobiographical Reflection Engine (harness-reflector)
context: Agent skills scaffolding multiple CLI utilities often develop fragmented data silos. In discovery-index-scout, search_index.py maintained a hardcoded static list of 46 curated sources while catalog_registry.py read and wrote to a local JSON registry file. ReAct agent step loops were forced to fork external subprocesses to search the catalog, and config overrides were ignored.
distilled_learning: Multi-script CLI skills must eliminate dual data silos by consolidating sources into a unified, slotted domain engine (DiscoveryCatalogEngine) supporting weighted multi-field search and faceted filtering. CLI frontends must be reduced to thin delegator wrappers, and capabilities elevated to a typed micro-kernel service protocol (DiscoveryIndexService) co-located under plugins/ (Rules 18, 44, 45, and 49) for zero-subprocess in-memory agent tool execution.

claims.assertion: Disparate CLI scripts with fragmented data stores produce data drift and prevent ReAct agent step loops from resolving tools in-memory.
Consolidating curated lists and local JSON stores into a slotted DiscoveryCatalogEngine with weighted BM25 ranking provides unified query access across static and user sources.
Elevating the domain engine to DiscoveryIndexService in src/harness/services/ and registering plugin = DiscoveryIndexScoutPlugin() enables direct IoC container resolution.
